## Purpose

Save and apply the chat-wide M3 second-pass atom/pattern evidence chain to Nebula **without copying the Synexia implementation and without editing Nebula widget production source**.

The Nebula branch is cut from current `master@831aa6bbf62388fe489a96a0332c63466700dd0e`.

## Exact upstream recipe binding

Nebula pins:

- repository: `hsoliwal/com.synexia`
- branch: `feat/m3-second-pass-signal-chain-20261004`
- commit: `9d33ce5229bee70872110b7a03e4ee99bf0e0878`
- upstream PR: `hsoliwal/com.synexia#8891`
- recipe: `com.synexia.rewrite.M3SecondPassAtomPatternRecipe`
- pass budget: `2`

The existing Nebula `m3-atomize-patternize` profile already activates
`com.synexia.rewrite.M3NebulaAtomizePatternizeRecipe`. On the pinned upstream branch that owner
includes the new second-pass chain through `M3RepositoryAtomizePatternizeRecipe`.

No duplicate Nebula implementation is introduced.

## Second-pass contract

```text
AST/LST inventory
  -> structural signals
  -> control-flow signals
  -> effect/contract signals
  -> lexically masked regex cues
  -> repeated-body evidence
  -> deterministic content-addressed fan-in
  -> candidate risk + typed residue + bounded fixed point
```

Regex is nomination-only after Java strings/chars/text blocks/comments are masked. It cannot certify
semantic equivalence or a transform. The current five recognizer leaves share a JVM-local signal
store, so external Camel/Airflow process fan-out is forbidden; external schedulers may treat the
second-pass composite as one atom until a content-addressed artifact handoff exists.

The pinned Synexia branch includes the torture fixture, typed residue, same-instance run-isolation
proof, lexical-mask hardening, Java problem-signature masking, and no mutation/replacement/promotion
authority.

## Nebula changes

- adds `m3/catalogue/second-pass-recipe-binding.tsv`;
- adds `NebulaM3SecondPassBinding` and JUnit custody tests;
- pins the exact recipe/commit/pass budget in `.m3/atom-pattern/policy.properties`;
- inserts `SECOND_PASS_SIGNAL_CHAIN` as read-only stage 3 before local mutation stages;
- shifts `FILE_FIXED_POINT` to stage 7;
- documents exact install/run semantics;
- annotates the existing Synexia OpenRewrite profile so arbitrary SNAPSHOTs are not treated as
  equivalent to the reviewed commit.

## Workflow repair

Current master had a duplicated/corrupted `m3-nebula-recipe-first.yml` from later merges:
repeated proof blocks, malformed `grep` lines, and repeated uploads.

This branch mechanically normalizes it to one proof sequence and restores exact custody and
promotion assertions.

A conditional cross-repository step is added:

- when `M3_SYNEXIA_TOKEN` is configured, checkout the exact pinned Synexia commit;
- install the Synexia recipe artifact;
- run only `com.synexia.rewrite.M3SecondPassAtomPattern` against Nebula twice;
- require zero source diff after both runs.
- without the token, emit `SECOND_PASS_EXECUTION=SKIPPED_NO_M3_SYNEXIA_TOKEN`; no false pass is
  claimed.

## Authority

This PR changes no widget/production Java.

Allowed changed surfaces are only:

- `m3/**`
- `.m3/**`
- root `pom.xml`
- `.github/workflows/m3-nebula-recipe-first.yml`

The second-pass binding has:

- source mutation authority = false
- replacement authority = false
- promotion authority = false

Nebula's existing tested FILE-local recipe remains the candidate mutation lane. Canonical promotion
remains serial/manual and proof-gated.

## Donor/JNI policy retained

The existing repository review remains:

`inventory -> LeetCode -> HackerRank -> GeeksforGeeks -> pinned GitHub donor/license review -> Java-before-JNI gate`.

Challenge platforms remain category/reference evidence only. JNI remains blocked until Java oracle,
differential corpus, lifecycle/fallback, and setup-inclusive benchmark evidence exist.

## Execution truth

The upstream dedicated Synexia second-pass Actions run currently fails before GitHub creates a job,
in the same broad repository workflow-startup pattern. That is not a Maven/JUnit result.

Therefore this PR is intentionally **draft**. Static/custody proof is present; hosted execution is
required before any promotion claim.
title: [M3] Bind fail-closed second-pass signal DAG to Nebula
